Class AlgoAlertEvaluationStateService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAlertEvaluationStateService
@Service public class AlgoAlertEvaluationStateService extends Object
Short transactions claim work; evaluation commits under the same pair lock, fencing expired lease owners.
